description: Ambient marketing context: inject `mktg status` (health, brand summary, next actions) at the start of every Claude Code session. Mirrors what `mktg setup` writes into .claude/settings.json. Fails soft when mktg is not on PATH.

hooks.command: command -v mktg >/dev/null 2>&1 && mktg status --fields health,brandSummary,nextActions --json 2>/dev/null || true
